title: How Many Ranks Does a Token Need? A Noise-Floor Squelch for Rank-One LoRA Experts
abstract: arXiv:2610.19033v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) applies every rank-one component of its update to every token, and mixture-of-experts variants replace this with a learned router that activates a fixed number of components. We argue that the number of components a token needs is a detection question with a classical answer. A token's responses to the rank-one components of a trained LoRA consist of a few large values on a Gaussian noise floor whose width matches that of an untrained adapter, and the floor carries cross-talk rather than adaptation. We introduce SQUELCH, a router-free mixture of rank-one experts that (i) soft-thresholds each token's responses at a multiple of its own robust noise level, so the active rank varies per token; (ii) chooses that multiple for each module by Stein's unbiased risk estimate, so no rank budget is specified; and (iii) replaces the resulting marginal keep-or-drop decisions by one explaining-away step on the value Gram matr

translated_title: 一个Token需要多少秩？——面向秩一LoRA专家的噪底静噪方法
translated_abstract: 低秩适配在每次更新中将其所有秩一分量应用于每个token，而其混合专家变体则改用学习到的路由器来激活固定数量的分量。我们认为，一个token所需的分量数量是一个具有经典答案的检测问题：训练后的LoRA的秩一分量对token的响应表现为高斯噪底之上的少数几个较大值，噪底宽度与未训练适配器的宽度一致，且噪底承载的是串扰而非适配信息。我们提出SQUELCH，一种无需路由器的秩一专家混合方法，它： 以每个token自身鲁棒噪声水平的倍数对其响应进行软阈值处理，从而使激活的秩随token而变化； 通过Stein无偏风险估计为每个模块选择该倍数，因此无需指定秩预算； 将由此得到的边缘式保留或丢弃决策替换为在值Gram矩阵上的一次解释消去步骤。
tldr: 提出无需路由器的秩一LoRA专家混合方法SQUELCH，通过基于噪底的软阈值处理和Stein无偏风险估计，让每个token自动决定所需的秩数量。
en_tdlr: SQUELCH is a router-free mixture of rank-one LoRA experts that automatically determines how many ranks each token needs via noise-floor-based soft thresholding and Stein's unbiased risk estimate.
